messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: service=streaming-inference env=prod metric=p99_latency value=3.8s threshold=2.5s — paging oncall
elaine (oncall): saw it, jumping in. can someone grab p95/p99 and impacted routes?
sam (sre): p95=820ms, p99=3.8s, error rate flat. spike started ~2934999880 (~3m ago). mostly on /v1/stream and /v1/chat-stream.
elaine (oncall): streaming stalls reported by Sentry too — a few reconnects. marking customer-impact = possible. maria (support): I have 2 tickets from customers saying streaming stalled and reconnects, one is high-traffic customer (cust-acme).
raj (runtime): looking at node telemetry — GPU IO wait on pool shared-gpu-4 high, NVMe write queues backed up. top offending tenant id=tenant-845 (batch workloads).
carlos (eng-infra): confirm cgroup iops for shared-gpu-4: tenant-845 cgroup blkio.weight=100, others 1000. they pushed a big quantization export job earlier.
elaine (oncall): urgent mitigations: 1) throttle tenant-845 IO, 2) evict or pause low-priority batch on that pool, 3) route streaming traffic to fallback pool if possible. who can run those?
raj (runtime): I can throttle via orchestration API: `POST /admin/tenants/tenant-845/actions` body `\{"action\":\"throttle_io\",\"rate\":\"50mbps\"\}` — will do now.
raj (runtime): done — request id `req-8a3f`. watching kernel metrics.
sam (sre): also killing 2 identified batch pods on shared-gpu-4: `kubectl delete pod batch-quant-57 --namespace=acct-845` (evicted, will respawn with lower priority).
carlos (eng-infra): temporarily bumped other tenants' blkio.weight to 1500 to reduce noisy neighbor impact. command run on hosts: `cgset -r blkio.weight=1500 /docker/12345` (rolled to pool hosts).
elaine (oncall): can we route streaming to dedicated-pool-1 for high-priority customers? deploy-bot: canary routing switch requires approval.
deploy-bot: auto-check: dedicated-pool-1 has 20% spare capacity, no active rollouts. request queued: `route-change-442`.
elaine (oncall): approve route-change-442, priority=manual-override.
deploy-bot: applied. route change active in ~12s.
maria (support): notifying affected customers (cust-acme) — sending message: "We're investigating streaming stalls, potential degraded latency, mitigation in progress."
raj (runtime): NVMe write queue length dropping now, host IO latency down 40%. p99 trending down.
sam (sre): p95 now 640ms, p99 1.6s. reconnects reduced.
elaine (oncall): good. logging incident type: noisy-neighbor IO -> mitigation: throttle tenant-845, evict batch pods, increase blkio for others, route critical streaming to dedicated-pool-1.
maria (support): cust-acme acknowledged and asked for a post-incident writeup.
carlos (eng-infra): we should also add an automated QoS rule: if blkio.latency > 200ms for >1m on shared pool, auto-throttle heavy tenants. filing infra ticket.
sam (sre): opening incident in PagerDuty -> PD-INC-89321, linking logs and perf graphs.
elaine (oncall): next steps: 1) confirm tenant-845 root cause (was a spike in batch export job), 2) follow up with quota/automation, 3) prepare RCA with perf graphs. assigning owners: raj -> root cause, carlos -> automation rule, sam -> incident doc, maria -> customer comms, jess (next-oncall) -> follow-up tomorrow.
jess (next-oncall): thanks, will take over at 08:00 UTC handoff. please drop any sticky notes before then.
elaine (oncall): handoff to @jess in 24m; leaving summary: mitigations applied, metrics improving, customer notified, PD ticket created.
incident-bot: NOTE: incident status -> mitigation, severity -> Sev2, incident_id=INC-2026-03-15-01
elaine (oncall): creating short postmortem stub now in /incidents/INC-2026-03-15-01, will update with timestamps and graphs.
sam (sre): archiving relevant profiler traces and attaching to PD ticket.
raj (runtime): final check: freeing KV caches for tenant-845 to reduce memory pressure. done.
maria (support): closing customer alerts for now; will reopen if they see issues. :thumbsup:
elaine (oncall): closing thread here — if p99 spikes again, page on-call. good job team.
